• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive, chicken free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Senior Chicken & Rice Recipe Dog Food includes a blend of chicken, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for adult dogs. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Chicken & Pea Recipe Grain Free Dog Food includes a blend of chicken, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.  
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Salmon & Kale Dog Food combines tasty real salmon, kale and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

Salmon, salmon meal, oatmeal, barley, brown rice, millet, sunflower oil, flax seed, dried plain beet pulp, kale, dried yeast, natural flavor, dehydrated alfalfa meal, dried tomato pomace, dicalcium phosphate, potassium chloride, calcium carbonate, salt, dried carrots, dried apricots, dried cherries, DL methionine, choline chloride, threonine, minerals (zinc proteinate, iron proteinate, selenium yeast, copper proteinate, magnesium proteinate, manganese proteinate, ethylenediamine dihydroiodide), inulin, brewers dried yeast, taurine, turmeric, vitamins (vitamin E supplement, niacin supplement, vitamin A supplement, thiamine mononitrate, d-calcium pantothenate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, riboflavin supplement, biotin, vitamin B12 supplement, folic acid, vitamin D3 supplement), hydrolyzed yeast, L-ascorbyl-2-polyphosphate (source of vitamin C), lactic acid, tocopherols (a preservative), yucca schidigera extract, yeast culture, dried Aspergillus oryzae fermentation extract, dried Bacillus subtilis fermentation product, dried Bacillus licheniformis fermentation product, dried Trichoderma longibrachiatum fermentation extract, dried Enterococcus faecium fermentation product, dried Lactobacillus acidophilus fermentation product, dried Bacillus subtilis fermentation extract, citric acid (a preservative), L-carnitine, rosemary extract.

Amount of food consumed will vary based on activity level, age, breed and environment. At 5 - 7 months, and again at about 12 months, your puppy will automatically reduce the amount consumed. This is due to a natural reduction in growth rate and the reduced need for calories. Consult your veterinarian if you believe your dog is too thin or overweight. Remember it is important to have clean, fresh water available for your dog at all times. Reproduction: NutriSource® PureVita™ Dog Food contains the nutrients essential for females in gestation and lactation. During gestation and lactation, food consumption will double or triple. Feeding Puppies: Begin feeding moistened NutriSource® PureVita™ Dog Food at 3 - 4 weeks of age. Continue feeding moistened food until puppies are able to chew easily. Puppies will consume up to 3 times the volume of food that an adult dog of the same weight would consume. Divide the daily ration for puppies into 3 feedings per day. After puppies rea

That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Lamb & Pumpkin Grain Free Puppy Food combines tasty real lamb, pumpkin and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages excluding growth of large size dogs (70 lbs. or more as an adult). 
 
• NutriSource PureVita puppy diets are specially formulated to support cognitive balance, training & behavior, and longevity & quality of life from day one.
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

Lamb, lamb meal, garbanzo beans, chickpea flour, dried plain beet pulp, sunflower oil, flax seed, tapioca starch, dried pumpkin, dried yeast, natural flavor, sunflower meal, salmon oil (preserved with tocopherols), potassium chloride, glycerol tributyrate, tannic acid, dried apples, dried apricots, DL methionine, choline chloride, salt, threonine, minerals (zinc proteinate, iron proteinate, selenium yeast, copper proteinate, magnesium proteinate, manganese proteinate, ethylenediamine dihydroiodide), brewers dried yeast, taurine, vitamins (vitamin E supplement, niacin supplement, vitamin A supplement, riboflavin supplement, d-calcium pantothenate, thiamine mononitrate, pyridoxine hydrochloride, vitamin B12 supplement, biotin, vitamin D3 supplement, folic acid), calcium carbonate, hydrolyzed yeast, L-ascorbyl-2-polyphosphate (source of vitamin C), lactic acid, L-carnitine, yucca schidigera extract, yeast culture, dried Aspergillus oryzae fermentation extract, dried Bacillus subtilis fermentation product, dried Bacillus licheniformis fermentation product, dried Trichoderma longibrachiatum fermentation extract, dried Enterococcus faecium fermentation product, dried Lactobacillus acidophilus fermentation product, dried Bacillus subtilis fermentation extract, citric acid (a preservative), L-tryptophan, rosemary extract.

Amount of food consumed will vary based on activity level, age, breed and environment. At 5 - 7 months, and again at about 12 months, your puppy will automatically reduce the amount consumed. This is due to a natural reduction in growth rate and the reduced need for calories. Consult your veterinarian if you believe your dog is too thin or overweight. Remember it is important to have clean, fresh water available for your dog at all times. sections.bodyString: Fuel your dog’s daily adventures with Zuke’s Mini Naturals Dog Treats. These treats for dogs are made of premium, real ingredients dogs love and offers them a high value rewarding dog treat they crave.
